bill_title: Combatting Illegal Immigration, Terrorist Organizations, and Transnational Organized Crime and Their Illegal Immigrant Participants
bill_desc: Revises definition of term "criminal gang" & defines term "transnational criminal organization"; authorizes penalty enhancement of certain offenses upon finding by factfinder that defendant committed charged offense for specified purposes; specifies that all profits, proceeds, & instrumentalities of hate group activity, terrorist organization activity, & transnational criminal organization activity & all property used or intended or attempted to be used to facilitate such criminal activity are subject to seizure & forfeiture under Florida Contraband Forfeiture Act; provides criminal penalties for persons who knowingly initiate, organize, plan, finance, direct, manage, or supervise hate group's activities, terrorist organization's activities, or transnational criminal organization's activities.
Establishes Office of Secure Florida within DOC; provides duties & responsibilities of office; & provides appropriation.

Prohibits licensed money services businesses from initiating foreign remittance transfers unless they have verified that sender is not unauthorized alien; defines "foreign remittance transfer"; requires licensees to submit certain forms & penalties to Office of Financial Regulation of FSC; requires office to deposit such penalties into certain fund; requires that licensees make, keep, & preserve for 5 years records of certain documentation & penalties paid; authorizes office to request, & requires licensees to provide, records of certain documentation; authorizes filing of complaints; provides criminal penalties for knowingly filing false or frivolous complaints; imposes requirements on office upon receipt of valid complaint substantiated by evidence of violation; specifies that failure to comply with certain provisions constitutes grounds for suspension of all licenses issued by office.
Requires penalty reclassification of certain crimes committed after unlawful reentry into United States.

Requiring law enforcement agencies to support enforcement of federal immigration law; requires, rather than authorizing, law enforcement agencies to transport certain persons securely to federal facility in this state or to another point of transfer to federal custody outside jurisdiction of law enforcement agency; specifies that certain provisions do not require state entity, local governmental entity, or law enforcement agency to provide federal immigration agency with information related to victim of or witness to criminal offense that occurred in this state & for which there is ongoing investigation or prosecution.

Requires each state & county law enforcement agency, & any other law enforcement agency with more than 25 sworn or certified law enforcement officers, to enter into written agreement with United States Immigration & Customs Enforcement to participate in certain immigration program; requires all state & county law enforcement agencies, & any other law enforcement agency with more than 25 sworn or certified law enforcement officers, to ensure at least certain percent of their sworn law enforcement officers are available to perform or exercise powers, privileges, or duties of immigration officer; authorizes Division of Emergency Management, in coordination with State Immigration Enforcement Officer, to adopt rules; creates Unauthorized Alien Transport Program within division; specifies that program is to be run by State Immigration Enforcement Officer; requires National Guard & State Guard to assist State Immigration Enforcement Officer in implementation of program; authorizes division, in coordination with State Immigration Enforcement Officer, to adopt rules; provides that all payments made pursuant to specified provisions are deemed approved; removes provisions relating to Unauthorized Alien Transport Program; provides appropriation.

Requires presumption that no conditions of release will secure appearance at trial of unauthorized alien; requires state attorney or court to move for pretrial detention if court makes certain determinations; authorizes defendants to rebut presumption.

Revises oath person subscribes to upon registering to vote; provides criminal penalties for unauthorized aliens who willfully swear or affirm to any oath or affirmation in connection with or arising out of voting or elections & for persons who have knowledge that such registrant is unauthorized alien; provides criminal penalties for unauthorized aliens who willfully submit false voter registration information & for persons who have knowledge that such registrant is unauthorized alien; provides criminal penalties for unauthorized aliens who, knowing that they are not qualified electors, willfully vote at any election & for persons who aid or solicit another person who is unauthorized alien to such action.

Provides that specified persons & entities are immune from liability for certain actions; creates civil cause of action for victims of crime committed by aliens against any person who knowingly & willfully aided or assisted alien in entering state; provides criminal penalties for adult aliens who knowingly enter or attempt to enter state after entering US by eluding or avoiding examination or inspection by immigration officers; requires arresting law enforcement agency to notify certain entities; provides criminal penalties for an adult alien who, after having been denied admission, excluded, deported, or removed or having departed US thereafter enters, attempts to enter, or is at any time found in this state; provides criminal penalties for persons who knowingly & willfully assist certain aliens who illegally entered or reentered US; provides affirmative defenses; authorizes defendant who is an alien to have any term of defendant's probationary sentence converted to administrative probation by DOC; requires department to be responsible for coordinating with defendant to arrange transportation; authorizes public funds to be used to procure transportation; requires court to verify certain information in hearing before defendant's departure from US.
Removes provisions relating to waiver of out-of-state fees for certain students, including students who are undocumented for federal immigration purposes.
Revising provisions related to constitutional amendments, signature verifications, filing fees, candidate petitions, citizen initiatives, fiscal impact, and petition forms.

Requiring the presumption that no conditions of release will secure the appearance at trial of an unauthorized alien; requiring the state attorney or the court to move for pretrial detention if the court makes certain determinations; authorizing defendants to rebut the presumption, etc.

Requiring law enforcement agencies to support the enforcement of federal immigration law; requiring, rather than authorizing, law enforcement agencies to transport certain persons securely to a federal facility in this state or to another point of transfer to federal custody outside the jurisdiction of the law enforcement agency, etc.

bill_title: Combatting Illegal Immigration, Terrorist Organizations, and Transnational Organized Crime and Their Illegal Immigrant Participants
bill_desc: Revising the definition of the term "criminal gang" and defining the term "transnational criminal organization"; authorizing the penalty enhancement of certain offenses upon a finding by the factfinder that the defendant committed the charged offense for specified purposes; specifying that all profits, proceeds, and instrumentalities of hate group activity, terrorist organization activity, and transnational criminal organization activity and all property used or intended or attempted to be used to facilitate such criminal activity are subject to seizure and forfeiture under the Florida Contraband Forfeiture Act; providing criminal penalties for persons who knowingly initiate, organize, plan, finance, direct, manage, or supervise a hate group's activities, terrorist organization's activities, or transnational criminal organization's activities, etc.
Requiring the penalty reclassification of certain crimes committed after unlawful reentry into the United States, etc.
Establishing the Office of Secure Florida within the Department of Commerce, etc.

Revising the oath a person subscribes to upon registering to vote; providing criminal penalties for unauthorized aliens who willfully swear or affirm to any oath or affirmation in connection with or arising out of voting or elections and for persons who have knowledge that such a registrant is an unauthorized alien, etc.

Requiring each state and county law enforcement agency, and any other law enforcement agency with more than 25 sworn or certified law enforcement officers, to enter into a written agreement with the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement to participate in a certain immigration program; creating the Unauthorized Alien Transport Program within the Division of Emergency Management, etc.

Prohibiting licensed money services businesses from initiating foreign remittance transfers unless they have verified that the sender is not an unauthorized alien; defining the term "foreign remittance transfer"; requiring the Financial Services Commission to adopt certain rules; requiring that licensees make, keep, and preserve for 5 years records of certain documentation and penalties paid; authorizing the Office of Financial Regulation of the commission to request, and requiring licensees to provide, records of certain documentation, etc.

Revising the criteria that the Attorney General uses when petitioning the Supreme Court for an advisory opinion related to a proposed revision or amendment to the State Constitution; requiring the Division of Elections to create a uniform petition form for candidates to gather signatures for a candidate petition; authorizing a supervisor of elections to verify certain signatures only if a certain petition form is used; requiring sponsors of an initiative amendment to register as political committees before circulating any initiative petition forms to voters; requiring the division to assign initiative petitions a petition number and create a certain form; authorizing that initiative petition forms approved by the Secretary of State may continue to be circulated, etc.
Deleting provisions relating to the waiver of out-of-state fees for certain students, including students who are undocumented for federal immigration purposes, etc.

Providing that specified persons and entities are immune from liability for damages arising from certain causes of action; requiring the state to indemnify certain elected or appointed persons; specifying that persons entitled to indemnification are entitled to representation by the Attorney General; creating a civil cause of action for victims of any crime committed by aliens under certain circumstances against any person who knowingly and willfully aided or assisted the alien in entering this state; providing criminal penalties for adult aliens who knowingly enter or attempt to enter this state after entering the United States by eluding or avoiding examination or inspection by immigration officers, etc.

Revises provisions related to immigration including identification of chief immigration officer & creation of Office of State Immigration Enforcement , duties, responsibilities, & requirements for such officer & office; creation of a grant program for certain purposes; noncitizen voting; noncitizen employment; drivers license & identification cards for noncitizens; immigration detainers; release of noncitizens from custody; cooperation & coordination with federal authorities & enforcement of immigration laws; emergencies related to immigration; & scholarships for noncitizens.

Citing this act as the "Tackling and Reforming Unlawful Migration Policy (TRUMP) Act"; providing that the Commissioner of Agriculture is the only person responsible for serving as liaison between certain entities regarding federal immigration laws; creating the Local Law Enforcement Immigration Grant Program within the Office of State Immigration Enforcement within the Division of Law Enforcement under the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services for specified purposes; creating the Office of State Immigration Enforcement within the Division of Law Enforcement under the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services for specified purposes, etc.

Revises provisions related to immigration including voting by noncitizens, valid identification, driver licenses, offenses committed by unauthorized aliens, unauthorized alien defendants, enforcement of federal immigration laws, immigration detainers, suspension from office, transport of unauthorized aliens, and fee waivers.

Revises provisions related to immigration including unauthorized aliens who enter the US without proper inspection, unauthorized aliens who have been denied admission, deported, excluded, or removed from the US, & unauthorized aliens who are convicted of capital offenses.
Urges Secretary of Homeland Security to provide guidance, training opportunities, & any other directives to ensure cooperation & coordination with 287(g) agreements.

bill_title: Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School Memorial Day
bill_desc: Recognizes February 14, 2025, as "Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School Memorial Day."

Providing that certain persons who vote in an election are guilty of a felony; prohibiting the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles from issuing a driver license or identification card to unauthorized aliens and undocumented immigrants; requiring a state attorney to seek to have the court sentence certain persons as dangerous unauthorized alien offenders; creating the State Board of Immigration Enforcement within the Department of Law Enforcement; creating the State Immigration Enforcement Council within the State Board of Immigration Enforcement for a specified purpose; requiring the Attorney General to initiate judicial proceedings in the name of the state in order to enforce compliance with an immigration detainer issued by a federal immigration agency; creating the Unauthorized Alien Transport Program within the Division of Emergency Management within the Executive Office of the Governor for a specified purpose, etc.

Providing criminal penalties for adult unauthorized aliens who knowingly enter or attempt to enter this state after entering the United States by eluding or avoiding examination or inspection by immigration officers; providing enhanced criminal penalties for second or subsequent convictions; specifying that such aliens are not eligible for any civil citation or other prearrest or postarrest diversion program; providing criminal penalties for an adult unauthorized alien who, after having been denied admission, excluded, deported, or removed or having departed the United States during the time an order of exclusion, deportation, or removal is outstanding, thereafter enters, attempts to enter, or is at any time found in this state, etc.
Urging the United States Department of Homeland Security to provide guidance and training opportunities for 287(g) agreements, etc.

bill_title: Municipal Water and Sewer Utility Rates
bill_desc: Requires municipality to charge customers receiving its utility services in another municipality same rates, fees, & charges as it charges consumers within its own municipal boundaries under certain circumstances.

bill_title: Windstorm Coverage by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
bill_desc: Requires Citizens Property Insurance Corporation to make windstorm coverage available to homeowners for any residential structures and to commercial lines residential structures; provides requirements for windstorm coverage; authorizes homeowners to obtain windstorm coverage from certain insurance agents; provides underwriting & administering requirements for windstorm coverage portion of insurance; provides requirements for claims settlement payments; revises requirements for corporation's plan of operation; revises certain statements obtained by agents from applicants for coverage from corporation.

bill_title: Storage of Handguns in Private Conveyances and Vessels
bill_desc: Provides requirements for storage of handguns in private conveyances & vessels; requires law enforcement agencies to engage in specified promotional campaign; requires counties to adopt specified ordinances concerning parents of children who have been found to have stolen handgun from conveyances or vessels.

Requires public middle schools to provide for administration of PSAT/NMSQT to students who meet specified criteria for specified purposes relating to Florida Bright Futures Program; requires specified test preparation resources & information be provided to certain students; provides for funding for such assessments & resources; & revises eligibility criteria for certain awards under Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program.

bill_title: Victims of Domestic Violence and Dating Violence
bill_desc: Requires Division of Telecommunications within DMS to consult with certain entities to conduct feasibility study regarding specified alert system; provides requirements for such alert system; requires division to report to Legislature results of feasibility study by specified date; revises legislative findings to include victims of dating violence; defines "dating violence"; authorizes victims of dating violence to apply to participate in Attorney General's address confidentiality program.

Authorizes Medicaid to reimburse for dental services provided by certain mobile dental units; creates Council on Dental Therapy; specifies licensure requirements, services, limitations, & prohibitions relating to practice of dental therapy; requires DOH, in consultation with Board of Dentistry & AHCA, to submit reports to Legislature.

Requires Board of Psychology to certify psychologists to exercise prescriptive authority if specified criteria are met; requires board to maintain current record of every prescribing psychologist authorized to prescribe controlled substances; requires board to establish interim panel; requires panel to submit recommendations for rules to board by specified date; requires panel to develop formulary for prescribing psychologists; provides for expiration of panel on specified date.

bill_title: Damages Recoverable in Wrongful Death Actions
bill_desc: Removes provision that prohibits adult children & parents of adult children from recovering certain damages in medical negligence suits.

Creates Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact; provides for recognition of access to social work services, including through telehealth, in member states; provides for development of data system, reporting procedures, & exchange of specified information between member states; specifies licensees practicing in remote state under compact must adhere to laws & rules of that state.

bill_title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact
bill_desc: Provides public records & meetings exemptions relating to Social Work Licensure Interstate Compact & its committees; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemptions; provides statements of public necessity.

bill_title: Carrying and Possession of Weapons and Firearms
bill_desc: Prohibits carrying of concealed handgun or unconcealed firearm without license & possession of such handgun or firearm without valid identification; repeals provisions relating to arrests without warrant & exemption from licensing requirements for law enforcement officers; allows open carrying of any otherwise legal firearm or electric weapon or device; revises list of places into which person may not carry handgun or concealed weapon or concealed firearm; provides exceptions; deletes provisions relating to open carry, collection of fees for licenses to carry concealed weapons or concealed firearms, allowing school districts to restrict possession of firearm in vehicle, exceptions to statutory protections of right to keep & bear arms in motor vehicles; revises definition of "bump-fire stock"; repeals provisions for risk protection orders.

bill_title: Agreement Among the States to Elect the President by National Popular Vote
bill_desc: Provides for enactment of Agreement Among States to Elect President by National Popular Vote; provides method by which state may become member state; requires statewide popular election for President & Vice President of U.S.; establishes procedure for appointing presidential electors in member states; provides that agreement becomes effective upon occurrence of specified actions; provides for withdrawal of member state; requires notification of member states when agreement takes effect in nonmember state or when member state withdraws from agreement.

Requires certain employers to implement outdoor heat exposure safety program that has been approved by specified departments; specifies requirements for safety program; provides responsibilities for certain employers & employees; provides exceptions; requires specified annual training on heat illness & providing requirements for such training.
Revises provisions relating to teacher & educator preparation programs and educator certification requirements to require certified educators to receive training relating to mass casualty incidents.
Increases value of tax exemption for certain disabled ex-servicemembers.

bill_title: Pub. Rec./Victims of Domestic Violence and Dating Violence
bill_desc: Provides that names, addresses, telephone numbers, & social security numbers of victims of dating violence who participate in Address Confidentiality Program for Victims of Domestic & Dating Violence are exempt from public records requirements; provides for retroactive application of exemption; provides for future legislative review & repeal; provides statement of public necessity.

Authorizes landlord to accept reusable tenant screening reports & require specified statement; requires that certain information be included in reusable tenant screening reports; prohibits landlord from charging certain fees to applicant using reusable tenant screening report.
Provides that person may not lose his or her resident status for tuition purposes due solely to his or her incarceration in specified correctional facilities.

bill_title: Child Care and Early Learning Providers
bill_desc: Provides exemption for public & private preschools from specified special assessments levied by municipality; defines "preschool"; revises licensing standards for all licensed child care facilities & minimum standards & training requirements for child care personnel; requires DCF to conduct specified screenings of child care personnel within specified timeframe & issue provisional approval of such personnel under certain conditions; revises minimum standards for sanitation & safety of child care facilities; removes provisions relating to educating parents & children about specified topics; removes provisions relating to specialized child care facilities for care of mildly ill children; requires county commission to annually affirm certain decisions; expands types of providers to be considered when developing & implementing plan to eliminate duplicative & unnecessary inspections; revises requirements for abbreviated inspection plan for certain child care facilities; removes provisions requiring family day care homes & large family child care homes to provide specified information to parents; removes provision requiring department to develop specified flyer; authorizes certain exempt child care facilities to submit application for licensure to department or local licensing agency.
Directs DHSMV to develop United States Naval Academy license plate; provides for distribution & use of fees collected from sale of plate.

Requires write-in candidates to pay certain fees; prohibits write-in candidate from being considered opponent for certain purposes; requires DOS to adopt rules for security of voting systems; requires such rules to prohibit connection to internet; authorizes counties to count ballots by hand at precinct level.
Requires background checks for sale or transfer of ammunition.

Provides exemption from public records requirements for records containing certain information pertaining to buyer or transferee who is not found to be prohibited from receipt or transfer of ammunition; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides statement of public necessity.

Excepts from list of Schedule I controlled substances certain xylazine animal drug products approved by USDA & used for certain purposes; provides criminal penalties & requiring mandatory minimum term of imprisonment specified offenses involving xylazine.

bill_title: Compensation of Victims of Wrongful Incarceration
bill_desc: Expands period during which petition for compensation for wrongful incarceration may be filed; provides that certain persons who had petitions dismissed or who had not previously filed such petitions may file such petitions; removes provisions excluding persons convicted of violent felonies from compensation; removes other exclusions; revises provisions concerning offset of civil judgments in favor of claimants against awards; provides that CFO may not draw warrant to purchase annuity for claimant in certain circumstances; revises provisions concerning continuing appropriations; provides that certain payments are subject to specific appropriation.

bill_title: Use of Campaign Funds for Child Care Expenses
bill_desc: Authorizes candidate to use funds on deposit in his or her campaign account to pay for child care expenses under specified conditions; requires candidates to maintain specified records for specified timeframe; requires candidates to disclose certain child care expenses in campaign finance reports.
Revises contract requirements for Florida Pregnancy Care Network, Inc.; requires DOH to conduct annual visits to each organization within network; providing requirements for visits.

bill_title: Sale, Transfer, and Storage of Firearms
bill_desc: Requires background checks on persons involved in firearm sales or transfers; requires firearm sales or transfers to be conducted through licensed dealer; revises requirements for safe storage of firearms; revises criminal penalties; requires firearms be sold by dealers with trigger locks or gun cases; revises warnings to be posted in gun dealerships; requires certain materials to be given to gun purchasers; prohibits specified acts involving unfinished firearm frames or receivers; prohibits certain activities involving three-dimensional printer or CNC milling machine.

bill_title: Acceptance of Cash Payments by Businesses
bill_desc: Requires certain businesses to accept cash payments for certain transactions; prohibits fees or conditions for such transactions; provides applicability & civil penalties; requires DACS to adopt rules.

Prohibits counties, municipalities, or other political subdivisions from adopting or enforcing certain local ordinances, regulations, rules, or policies regarding presidential libraries unless authorized by federal law.

bill_title: Civil Actions Brought by Unauthorized Aliens
bill_desc: Prohibits unauthorized alien from commencing civil actions.

Transfers duties related to bacteriological sampling of beach waters & public bathing places from DOH to DEP; provides requirements for such transfer; revises provisions related to bacteriological sampling of beach waters & public bathing places, including rule adoption & enforcement; issuance of health advisories; closure of beach waters & public bathing places; notification & signage requirements; & public statewide interagency database.

bill_title: Display of Flags by Governmental Entities
bill_desc: Prohibits governmental entities from erecting or displaying certain flags; requires governmental entities to remain neutral in certain circumstances; requires that United States flag displayed by governmental entities be in certain position relative to other flags; authorizes current or retired member of United States Armed Forces or National Guard to use reasonable force to prevent desecration, destruction, or removal of United States flag or to replace such flag to position of prominence.

bill_title: Recall of County Officers and Commissioners
bill_desc: Proposes amendment to State Constitution to authorize recall of county officers & commissioners by electors of this state.

bill_title: Animal Cruelty During a Declared State of Emergency
bill_desc: Provides increased criminal penalties for animal cruelty offenses committed during declared state of emergency.

Designates American flamingo as official state bird and the Florida scrub-jay as the official state songbird; provides that such designation supersedes designation of mockingbird as official Florida state bird.

bill_title: Protections for Public Employees who use Medical Marijuana as Qualified Patients
bill_desc: Prohibits public employer from taking adverse personnel action against employee or job applicant for his or her use of medical marijuana if employee or job applicant is qualified patient; provides exceptions; requires public employer to provide written notice of employee's or job applicant's right to explain or contest positive marijuana test result within specified timeframe; provides procedures that apply when employee or job applicant tests positive for marijuana; provides cause of action & damages.
Revises criteria that determine hazardous walking condition for public school students.
Revises definition of term "cancer" to include acute myeloid leukemia for purpose of expanding cancer treatment benefits.

Authorizes local government to enact land development regulations to permit land use for small-footprint grocery store located in food insecure area; authorizes local government to include in its comprehensive plan provision permitting land use for small-footprint grocery store located in food insecure area; authorizes local government to require mandatory reporting of certain information from small-footprint grocery store.
Increases probationary periods for certain misdemeanor offenses involving controlled or chemical substances.

Requires swimming pools located on residential real property that is transferred or sold on or after specified date to meet certain pool safety & pool barrier requirements; requires certain persons to report violations of law to local law enforcement agency.

Authorizes prisoner in state prison who has unserved warrant to file notice of such unserved warrant in circuit court where warrant was issued; requires prisoner to serve notice on state attorney; requires court to schedule status hearing within certain time; specifies procedures; provides for prosecution of violation.

bill_title: Service of Process in Proceedings for Protection of Vulnerable Adults
bill_desc: Authorizes use of substitute service on unascertainable respondents; requires that any proposed transfer of funds or property in dispute be held for specified time period.

bill_title: Graduation Requirements for English for Speakers of Other Languages Program Students
bill_desc: Authorizes certain ESOL program students to meet Algebra I end-of-course assessment requirements in specified manner.
Authorizes delivery of hearing aids through mail.
Requires hospitals & ambulatory surgical centers to adopt & implement policies requiring use of smoke evacuation systems during certain surgical procedures.

Revises provisions related to pari-mutuel wagering including thoroughbred permitholders, live racing, awards, purses, handle, eligibility, transfer of funds, conversion of permits, transfers of permits, thoroughbred racing centers, & licenses.
Designates Chanda Cheeseborough Ribault River Bridge in Duval County; directs DOT to erect suitable markers.

bill_title: Photography In Polling Rooms and Early Voting Sites
bill_desc: Authorizes photography at polling rooms & early voting areas at specified times.

bill_title: Sales Tax Exemption for Disabled Veterans
bill_desc: Creates exemption from specified taxes for sales made to certain veterans; requires person seeking exemption to apply to DOR.

bill_title: Fleeing or Attempting to Elude a Law Enforcement Officer
bill_desc: Revises law enforcement vehicle marking requirements for specified offenses; reclassifies offenses for purposes of offense severity ranking chart of Criminal Punishment Code; provides sentencing multiplier for specified offenses.

Requires that applicant that qualifies for licensure provides proof of such compliance & pays required fees be deemed eligible for licensure; provides that applicants for licensure as technologist or technician who meet specified criteria be deemed to have satisfied minimum qualifications for licensure to perform high or moderate complexity testing as technologist or technician, as applicable.

Requires unlicensed vendor providing home repair services to take certain actions within a specified timeframe after receiving payment; provides that unlicensed vendor has burden to prove just cause; provides criminal penalties; modifies exemption from certain permitting requirements for certain solicitors, salespersons, and agents.

bill_title: Universal Free School Breakfast and Lunch Program
bill_desc: Requires DACS, subject to appropriation of certain funds, to establish & operate Universal Free School Breakfast & Lunch a Program in public schools; specifies requirements for school districts; authorizes school districts to operate program using offsite food preparation locations.
Revises criteria required for grandparent of minor child to petition court for grandparent visitation.

Revises provisions relating to conversion schools; authorizes municipality to apply for job engine charter under certain conditions; prohibits school districts from charging specified fees for conversion school; & requires specified property to remain at conversion school.

Removes religious colleges from list of institutions specified as not being under jurisdiction or purview of Commission for Independent Education; provides requirements that must be met by nonpublic religious postsecondary educational institutions that operate without being licensed by commission; provides duties & requirements of the commission & institutions; & provides specified persons are subject to certain criminal penalties.

Requires DOE to develop & implement, by specified date, workforce credential program for students with autism spectrum disorder or students on modified curriculum; provides purpose of program; provides requirements for program; & provides reporting requirements.

bill_title: Products Liability Actions under the Florida Pesticide Law
bill_desc: Prohibits pesticide-related products liability action for failure to warn if pesticide's label meets specified conditions; provides exception.
Provides that certain patients may receive ultrasound or other additional screening tests without first having conventional mammogram.

Authorizes Board of Accountancy to contract with certain corporations not for profit for performance of certain duties assigned to Division of Certified Public Accounting of DBPR; revises education & work experience requirements for certified public accountant license; requires international applicant who seeks licensure as certified public accountant in this state to meet specified criteria prescribed by board; revises requirements for approval of providers who administer continuing education on ethics for certified public accountants; revises requirements for certified public accountants licensed in another state or territory of United States to practice in this state without obtaining license.

Requires program to set aside certain amount of funds to provide tuition assistance to spouses & children of active members of Florida National Guard; requires Department of Military Affairs to oversee implementation & enforcement; requires department to establish certain procedures.

Creates Office of Homeowners' Association Ombudsman within Division of Florida Condominiums, Timeshares, & Mobile Homes of DBPR; provides for funding of office; directs Governor to appoint ombudsman; provides requirements for ombudsman; prohibits ombudsman & officers & full-time employees of office from holding certain positions, engaging in certain activities, or receiving certain remuneration; provides for principal location of ombudsman's office; specifies powers & duties of ombudsman; provides for administration of election monitoring process; provides that specified rule governs administration of election monitoring.
Authorizes pawnbroker transaction forms to be in digital or printed formats.

bill_title: State Group Insurance Program Coverage for Diagnostic and Supplemental Breast Examinations
bill_desc: Prohibits state group insurance program from imposing enrollee cost-sharing liability with respect to coverage for diagnostic breast examinations & supplemental breast examinations.

Authorizes owner of resilient buildings to receive specified tax credit; provides specifications for tax credit application, value, requirements, use, & transfer; creates Florida Resilient Building Advisory Council; provides duties, membership, & meeting requirements for such council.

Requires every female who is arrested & not released within 72 hours after arrest be administered pregnancy test upon request; requires that each municipal or county detention facility notify each arrested female of right to request pregnancy test; authorizes sentencing court to stay beginning of period of incarceration; authorizes court to order pregnant woman to comply with specified terms & conditions during stay; requires that woman be offered specified assessment & services; requires detention facilities & DOC to collect & report specified information.

bill_title: Prohibited Practices in Consumer Debt Collection
bill_desc: Provides applicability of certain prohibited practices in consumer debt collection.

bill_title: Claims for Adverse Reactions to Vaccine and Drugs under the Medicaid and Medically Needy Programs
bill_desc: Requires AHCA to expedite review & payment process for claims related to adverse reactions to vaccines, immunizing agents, & emergency countermeasure drugs under Medicaid & Florida Medicaid medically needy programs.

Revises provisions relating to private schools & students participating in FHSAA sports, FHSAA board of directors & committees on appeals, & certain appeals; requires specified information be posted online.
Provides enhanced criminal penalties for knowingly sheltering unmarried minor or aiding unmarried minor runaway; creates presumption concerning knowledge of minor's age; provides defense.

Provides public records exemption for personal identifying & location information of current or former employees of Judicial Qualifications Commission & their spouse & children; provides for retroactive application; provides for future legislative review & repeal; provides statement of public necessity.

Expands hours during which registered agents are required to keep designated registered office; specifies that certain registered agents may be served process in specified manner; authorizes service of process by personally serving receiver for specified domestic entities in receivership during pendency of receivership; requires that certain substituted service of process be issued in name of party to be served in care of SOS; authorizes use of specified substituted service method; provides that SOS & DOS are not parties to lawsuits & may not be served additional court filings by reason of specified substituted service; authorizes substituted service on SOS in specified circumstances; provides retroactive application.

Requires development of statewide standardized assessments & portions of coordinated screening & monitoring system in specified languages by specified school year; provides requirements for DOE; authorizes parents to prohibit use of such assessments & system in languages other than English.
Revises exception to maximum allowable capacity for individual container of wine sold in this state.

bill_title: Ad Valorem Property Tax Exemption for the Surviving Spouse of Quadriplegics
bill_desc: Proposes amendment to State Constitution to authorize Legislature to provide for property tax exemption for surviving spouse of quadriplegic who was receiving property tax exemption on real estate used & owned as homestead at time of their death.

bill_title: Tax Exemptions for Surviving Spouses of Quadriplegics
bill_desc: Authorizes surviving spouses of certain quadriplegics to carry over certain tax exemption in certain circumstances.
Requires public high schools to establish Bright Futures Scholarship mentorship program for students; & provides requirements for such program.

Creates task force within FDLE; requires state agencies to provide assistance when requested; authorizes task force to receive exempt or confidential & exempt information & specifies that information maintains such status; requires report.

bill_title: Youth Conflict Resolution and Peer Mediation Pilot Program
bill_desc: Establishes Youth Conflict Resolution and Peer Mediation Pilot Program within the Community School Grant Program; provides requirements for program.

bill_title: Interest on Trust Accounts Program Interest Rates
bill_desc: Requires CFO to establish quarterly two interest rate alternatives applicable to Interest on Trust Accounts (IOTA) Program to determine interest paid to Funding Florida Legal Aid (FFLA) by participating financial institutions; requires such institutions to select one of two rate alternatives annually; requires that each rate alternative be set at specified rate; requires CFO to inform FFLA of rate alternatives established for each upcoming quarter; provides applicability.

bill_title: Criminal Offenses Against Law Enforcement Officers and Other Personnel
bill_desc: Revises provisions concerning assault or battery upon specified officers; provides for enhanced punishment for additional offenses when committed against specified officers; revises prohibition on use or threatened use of force to resist arrest or detention; revises provision concerning resisting, obstructing, or opposing specified officers.
Provides honorary designations of certain transportation facilities in specified counties; directs DOT to erect suitable markers.

bill_title: Florida Institute for Human and Machine Cognition, Inc.
bill_desc: Requires board of directors of Florida Institute for Human & Machine Cognition, Inc., rather than BOG, to authorize creation of subsidiary of corporation; requires corporation, rather than Board of Trustees of UWF, to annually certify specified information to Governor, Legislature, & BOG; & authorizes any authorized & approved subsidiary of corporation to enter into affiliation agreements.

Requires Florida Commission on Offender Review to provide specified statistical analysis to Legislature; requires DOC to provide specified information to commission; requires commission to review specified information in certain circumstances.

Specifies to rehabilitate offender to transition back to community successfully is one of primary purposes of sentencing; reduces minimum sentence that must be served by defendant from 85 percent of sentence to 72 percent; revises provisions concerning gain-time to provide for outstanding deed gain-time, good behavior time, & rehabilitation credits; revises limits on awards.

Specifies rights of inmates in state correctional system; requires written copy of rights to be provided to each inmate; authorizes relief for deprivation of rights; revises definition of "permanently incapacitated inmate" for purposes of conditional medical release.

bill_title: Coverage for Mammograms and Supplemental Breast Cancer Screenings
bill_desc: Requires AHCA to provide coverage for yearly mammograms & yearly supplemental breast cancer screenings for certain women; revises coverages for mammograms under certain individual accident & health insurance policies, group, blanket, & franchise accident & health insurance policies, & health maintenance contracts; requires coverages for supplemental breast cancer screenings under such policies & contracts under certain circumstances.

bill_title: Comprehensive Waste Reduction and Recycling Plan
bill_desc: Authorizes certain private businesses to participate in program to annually report amount of materials they recycle, using specified form; requires DEP to develop comprehensive waste reduction & recycling plan by specified date, based on certain department recommendations; specifies minimum requirements for comprehensive plan; requires department to publish report.

bill_title: Instructional Hours for the Voluntary Prekindergarten Education Program
bill_desc: Revises instructional hours required to be delivered in Voluntary Prekindergarten Education Program for school-year & summer programs.

Revises provisions of law relating to Child Protection Team investigators; duties & responsibilities of DCF & law enforcement officers regarding parenting plans & custody arrangements; reports of child abuse, abandonment, or neglect; interference with custody; emergency hearings; Children & Youth Cabinet; domestic violence; responsibilities of law enforcement officers when investigating potential domestic violence or interference with custody issues; responsibilities of schools to enforce & adhere to parenting plans or court order; & criminal penalties.

bill_title: Education in Correctional Facilities for Licensed Professions
bill_desc: Requires Correctional Education Program to develop plan in coordination with boards of professions within DBPR, or DBPR when there is no board, for inmates to take classes for credit toward licensure requirements.

bill_title: Council on Social Status of Black Men and Boys
bill_desc: Revises quorum requirements for Council on Social Status of Black Men & Boys; authorizes members to appear by communications media technology; provides that members who appear by such technology are considered present & may be counted toward quorum requirement.

bill_title: Tax of Electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing Aircraft
bill_desc: Exempts from state sales tax lease, sale, or transfer of electric vertical takeoff & landing (eVTOL) aircraft from manufacturer to operator.

Provides eligibility requirements for persons seeking to qualify for nomination as candidates of political party or with no party affiliation; provides certain entities may bring action for declaratory & injunctive relief; prohibits person from qualifying as candidate for election & prohibiting his or her name from appearing on ballot.
Revises facilities required to be identified in capital improvements element of comprehensive plan that imposes transportation concurrency for small counties.

bill_title: Abandoning Restrained Dogs During Natural Disasters
bill_desc: Prohibits restraining dog outside during natural disaster & thereafter abandoning dog.

bill_title: Door Alarms for Multifamily Residential Properties
bill_desc: Requires certain properties to install & maintain door alarms on certain doors beginning on specified date; specifies person responsible for installing & maintaining such door alarms; requires door alarms to be inspected annually; requires documentation of such inspection be maintained for certain length of time; requires door alarms to be compliant with Florida Building Code; requires DBPR to enforce this act & authorizes department to use any enforcement action authorized by law; provides administrative fines.

Requiring public hearings for all updated conservation and nonconservation land management plans; requiring the Division of State Lands of the Department of Environmental Protection to make available to the public, within a specified timeframe, electronic copies of land management plans for parcels of a certain size and for parcels located in state parks; revising the duties of the Division of Recreation and Parks of the Department of Environmental Protection; specifying requirements for the management of parks and recreational areas held by the state; requiring the division to comply with specified provisions when granting certain privileges, leases, concessions, and permits; authorizing the division to acquire, install, or permit the installation or operation at state parks of campsites and cabins that meet certain requirements; prohibiting the division from authorizing certain uses or construction activities within a state park; prohibiting the division from installing or permitting the installation of any lodging establishment within the boundaries of a state park; requiring that individual management plans for parcels located within state parks be developed with input from an advisory group; requiring that the advisory group's required public hearings be noticed to the public within a specified timeframe, etc.

Provides that collection, storage, processing, & distribution of farm product is activity of bona fide farm operation which governmental entity may not prohibit, restrict, regulate, or otherwise limit.

Specifies requirement for complaint to remove an unauthorized person from residential real property; authorizes commercial property owner or agent to request sheriff to immediately remove persons unlawfully occupying real property if specified conditions met; specifies requirements for sheriff upon receipt of complaint; authorizes sheriff to arrest unauthorized person for legal cause; provides that sheriffs are entitled to specified fee for service of notice to vacate; authorizes owner or agent to request that sheriff stand by while owner or agent takes possession of commercial real property; prohibits person from unlawfully detaining or occupying or trespassing upon commercial real property & intentionally causing specified amount of damage; prohibits listing or advertising for sale, or renting or leasing, real property under certain circumstances.

Establishes Construction Impact Relief Program within Department of Commerce pursuant to Florida Job Growth Grant Fund; requires department to provide specified financial assistance to eligible small businesses within construction zones; requires department to develop public awareness & marketing campaign to promote program; requires applicants to submit specified information with their applications; directs department to establish hotline to provide information about program; establishes annual reporting requirement.

bill_title: Property Tax Exemption for Surviving Spouses of Veterans
bill_desc: Authorizes surviving spouses of veterans who predecease issuance of certain letter from Federal Government to produce letter before property appraiser.
Authorizes specified screening services to be performed on K-12 students after written parental notification of such services is provided & student's parents are given specified opportunities.

Authorizes utility terrain vehicle (UTV) to be operated during all hours; authorizes operation of UTVs on certain roadways; authorizes operation of UTVs on certain parts of State Highway System; authorizes DOT to prohibit use of UTVs; authorizes persons possessing certain licenses to operate UTV; requires owners or operators of UTV to comply with certain requirements & regulations; authorizes county or municipality to restrict operation of UTVs; provides civil penalties; requires DHSMV to issue license plate to owner or lessee of vehicle registered as UTV upon payment of certain taxes & fees; requires that license plates for UTVs comply with specified provisions.

bill_title: Electronic Monitoring Devices in Long-term Care Facilities
bill_desc: Defines "electronic monitoring device" & "representative"; authorizes resident, or his or her representative, of nursing home facility or assisted living facility, respectively, to install & use electronic monitoring device in resident's room if specified conditions are met; provides for consent of resident living in shared room with resident who intends to install device; authorizes other resident or his or her representative to impose conditions on consent; provides for withdrawal of consent & modification of conditions; requires AHCA to adopt forms by rule; prohibits facilities from denying admission or otherwise discriminating against resident for installing electronic monitoring device; provides administrative penalty; provides criminal penalty for unlawfully obstructing, tampering with, or destroying electronic monitoring device or recording made by such device; specifies who may view or listen to images & sounds broadcast or recorded by electronic monitoring device.

bill_title: Subsidy Payments for the Home Care for the Elderly Program
bill_desc: Requires that subsidy payments made by DOEA for home care for elderly program cease for certain persons upon such persons' participation in Medicaid long-term care managed care program.

Authorizes taxpayers to rescind homestead exemption applications; provides requirements for rescinding such applications; requires property appraiser to adjust tax rolls; revises conditions under which property is entitled to certain exemptions.

Revises definition of term "health facility"; authorizes authority to make mortgage or other secured or unsecured loans & refund or refinance outstanding bonds, obligations, loans, indebtedness, or advances issued, made, given, or incurred by or for benefit of any health facility for cost of project in accordance with specified agreement; authorizes authority to lease certain projects to health facility under loan agreement; provides that specified projects financed by authority shall be governed by one or more loan agreements; provides requirements for such loan agreements; authorizes authority to require certain health facilities to operate, repair, & maintain projects & bear certain costs; authorizes issuance of revenue bonds of other issuers if proceeds were used for specified purposes; provides requirements for closure of not-for-profit hospitals; provides tax exemption criteria for hospitals.

Provides public records exemption for personal identifying & location information of current & former medical examiners & spouses & children of such medical examiners; provides for future legislative review & repeal; provides for retroactive application.
Prohibits creation, download, or possession of photograph or image of person with intention of using such photograph or image to create generated child pornography.

Requires certain portable wireless device manufacturers to make certain items available to device owners & independent repair providers; prohibits certain manufacturers from requiring authorized repair providers to continue purchasing certain information in proprietary format; establishes enforcement provisions.

bill_title: Fees for the Recordkeeping System for Ephedrine and Related Compounds
bill_desc: Requires manufacturers of ephedrine or related compounds to pay fee to operate an electronic recordkeeping system; provides for establishment of fee schedule.

Requires minimum ratios of school psychologists & of certified school counselors, school social workers, or other licensed mental health professionals to students in certain grades, respectively, beginning with specified school year.
Provides that person may not drive on street at unlawful speed; prohibits operation of motor vehicle, vessel, or other conveyance at speed that creates excessive wake.

bill_title: Withholding Funds from the Return of Cash Bonds
bill_desc: Requires clerk of court to withhold funds from return of cash bond posted by criminal defendant or his or her spouse, rather than to withhold from return of cash bond posted on behalf of criminal defendant by person other than bail bond agent, funds for specified purposes; requires all cash bond forms to display specified notice.

Requires each law enforcement agency operating detention facility to enter into specified agreement with United States Immigration & Customs Enforcement; requires certain law enforcement agencies to report specified information quarterly to FDLE.

Authorizes landlord to accept reusable tenant screening reports & require specified statement; prohibits landlord from charging certain fees to applicant using reusable tenant screening report; requires, rather than authorizes, local governments to adopt ordinance to allow accessory dwelling units in certain areas; revises accessory dwelling units that apply toward satisfying certain component of local government's comprehensive plan; requires that rented accessory dwelling unit be assessed separately from homestead property & taxed according to its use; prohibits local governments from adopting ordinance to allow accessory dwelling units in areas of critical state concern; authorizes local government to provide density bonus incentive to landowners who make certain real property donations to assist in provision of affordable housing for military families.

Prohibits person from establishing, promoting, operating, or participating in pyramid promotional scheme; requires DLA to issue & serve complaint & cease & desist order; establishes procedures for cease & desist orders; provides for restitution; authorizes DLA to apply for injunction; provides requirements for injunction; authorizes court to appoint receiver; provides for powers & duties of such receivership; authorizes court to issue order to stay certain actions & requires such actions be assigned to judge who appointed receiver; provides that specified provisions & penalties are in addition to civil, administrative, or criminal actions provided by law.

Requires Governor to proclaim specified day annually as "Holocaust Remembrance Day"; authorizes "Holocaust Remembrance Day" to be observed in this state's public schools & be observed by public exercise as Governor may designate; authorizes specified instruction.

Reclassifies offense of driving, moving, or causing to be moved vehicle or equipment with certain lighting on highway as third degree felony in specified circumstance; increases the penalty for knowingly altering a motor vehicle registration certificate, a license plate, a temporary license plate, a mobile home sticker, or a validation sticker or obscuring a license plate from a noncriminal traffic infraction to a second degree misdemeanor; provides criminal penalties if person purchases, possesses, manufactures, sells, offers to sell, or otherwise distributes license plate obscuring device; provides enhanced penalty if person uses license plate obscuring device for specified purposes.

Requires the Department of Law Enforcement to post on its website the names of certain individuals who have violated specified animal cruelty provisions; provides a sentencing multiplier for specified offenses of aggravated animal cruelty.

bill_title: Exceptional Students and Video Cameras in Public Schools
bill_desc: Removes references to Video Cameras in Public School Classrooms Pilot Program; removes obsolete definition; requires certain district school boards to vote to establish policy to provide video cameras in self-contained classrooms upon request of parent; prohibits school or school district from concealing identity of employee in video recording; & provides that video recording made available after request must include accompanying audio.

Designates August 21 of each year as "Fentanyl Awareness & Education Day"; encourages specified entities & public schools to sponsor events to promote awareness of dangers of fentanyl & potential overdoses, including education on specified topics.

bill_title: Middle School and High School Start Times
bill_desc: Provides that schools districts & charter schools are in compliance with certain provisions relating to middle school & high school start times upon submission of specified report to DOE.
Prohibits person from confining an animal in an unattended motor vehicle in certain circumstances.

bill_title: Postjudgment Execution Proceedings Relating to Terrorism
bill_desc: Provides additional requirements for postjudgment execution proceedings to enforce judgments entered against terrorist parties under specified provisions; provides retroactive application of specified provisions.

Requires DHSMV to develop Endless Summer motorcycle specialty license plate; specifies design requirement for plate; requires that number of valid Endless Summer motor vehicle & motorcycle specialty license plates be added together for purposes of certain determination.

bill_title: Disability Provisions for Firefighters and Law Enforcement and Correctional Officers
bill_desc: Provides & revises definitions relating to certain disabilities of firefighters & law enforcement & correctional officers.

Expands grounds for reclassification of crimes to include acts based on gender or gender identity of any person; specifies that reclassification must occur if crime was based in whole or in part on specified characteristics; specifies that reclassification of certain crime must occur if crime was based in whole or in part on disability of any person; expands data Governor is required to collect & disseminate.

Authorizes registered pharmacy technicians to handle sales transactions & delivery of dispensed drugs; provides for permitting of remote-site pharmacies; requires that licensed or consultant pharmacist serve as prescription department manager of remote-site pharmacy; requires remote-site pharmacies to notify DOH of change in pharmacy's prescription department manager within specified timeframe; provides requirements for remote-site pharmacies; authorizes remote-site pharmacies to store, hold, & dispense medicinal drugs; prohibits dispensing of Schedule II medications at remote-site pharmacies unless pharmacist is present; requires prescription department managers to visit remote-site pharmacies, based on certain schedule, to perform specified tasks; prohibits remote-site pharmacies from being open when supervising pharmacy is closed unless certain pharmacist is present or providing remote supervision at remote-site pharmacy; exempts registered pharmacists serving as prescription department managers for remote-site pharmacies from certain practice limitations
Requires municipality proposing to annex state-owned lands to notify each member of legislative delegation of county at certain time.

Prohibits person from receiving compensation for referring individual to another person for advising, assisting, or consulting on veterans' benefits matters; authorizes compensation for services rendered during specified period only; requires that persons who advise, assist, or consult on veterans' benefits matters for compensation provide specified disclosures before entering into business relationship with client; prohibits providers who advise, assist, or consult on veterans' benefits matters from charging certain fees; prohibits charging of interest on payment plans; provides requirements in event of death of veteran claimant; provides security requirements for handling of veteran's personal & account information; requires provider to successfully complete specified background screening; provides that violation is deceptive & unfair trade practice which may be subject to specified penalties.

Provides enhanced criminal penalties for specified violation relating to use of emergency communications services which results in great bodily harm, permanent disfigurement, permanent disability, or death; revises requirements for specified violation relating to continued misuse of emergency communications services; provides that conviction includes determination of guilt regardless of whether adjudication is withheld or plea of nolo contendere is entered; requires courts to order person convicted of violation to pay costs of prosecution & investigation & restitution for certain damages & injuries; requires courts to order person convicted of violation to pay costs of prosecution & investigation & restitution for certain damages & injuries; ranking offenses on offense severity ranking chart of Criminal Punishment Code.

Authorizes county or municipality to designate special magistrate; authorizes local governmental entity to assess administrative fees through adoption of alternate code enforcement system; revises circumstances in which enforcement board must declare enforcement board member's office vacant; revises code violation notice, correction period, & hearing process; revises method by which certain notices must be provided to alleged code violator; requires governmental entity that permits its code inspectors to wear body cameras to establish certain policies & procedures; requires such governmental entity to ensure that certain training occurs, retain certain data in accordance with public records laws, & perform periodic review of actual body camera practices; increases criminal penalties for certain crimes committed against code inspector in certain circumstances.

bill_title: Storage and Disposal of Prescription Drugs and Sharps
bill_desc: Requires DOH & DEP to conduct study of safe collection & proper disposal of sharps; requires departments to make specified assessment of use of sharps in home; establishes collection methods to be considered in conducting study; requires departments to submit specified report to Governor & Legislature by certain date; provides for appropriation; provides requirements for establishments that store, warehouse, or hold certain prescription drugs solely for purpose of destruction.

bill_title: Injunctions for Protection in Cases of Repeat or Serious Violence
bill_desc: Expands grounds for injunction of protection to include serious violence in addition to repeat violence.

bill_title: Building and Plumbing Permits for the Use of Onsite Sewage Treatment and Disposal Systems
bill_desc: Revises conditions under which municipalities & political subdivisions are prohibited from issuing certain building & plumbing permits for use of onsite sewage treatment & disposal systems.

Revises & provides penalties for vessel collisions, accidents, casualties, reckless operation, & providing false information in specified reports; revises requirements for operating certain vessels; requires person convicted of certain noncriminal infractions to pay fine; provides minimum mandatory prison term for BUI manslaughter.

bill_title: Personal Mobility Device Battery Safety Standards
bill_desc: Defines "personal mobility device"; prohibits sale of personal mobility device using battery that is not certified as meeting specified ingress protection standard; provides penalties.

Establishes Office of Faith & Community within EOG for specified purpose; specifies duties of Office of Faith & Community; provides for appointment of liaison for faith & community; specifies duties of liaison for faith & community; provides that Office of Faith & Community provides administrative support to Florida Faith-Based & Community-Based Advisory Council.

bill_title: Comprehensive Waste Reduction and Recycling Plan
bill_desc: Requires DEP to develop comprehensive waste reduction & recycling plan, create & convene technical assistance group, & submit report to Legislature.

Requires operators, ticket resellers, & online ticket marketplaces to disclose specified information during ticket listing & purchasing process; specifies prohibited practices; authorizes Secretary of Commerce to receive specified information about technology & security measures from online ticket marketplaces; specifies that trade secrets received by secretary remain confidential when shared with attorney general; authorizes Secretary of Commerce to enforce certain provisions.
Requires elevator car interiors to have at least one support rail that meets certain specifications.

Increases statutory limits on liability for tort claims against state & its agencies & subdivisions; authorizes subdivision to settle claim in excess of statutory limit without legislative action regardless of insurance coverage limits; prohibits insurance policy from conditioning benefits on enactment of claim bill; specifies that limitations in effect on date claim accrues apply to that claim; revises period within which certain claims must be presented; revises exceptions relating to instituting tort claims against state or agencies or subdivisions; revises period after which failure of certain entities to make final disposition of claim shall be deemed final denial of claim for certain purposes; revises statute of limitations for tort claims against state or one of its agencies or subdivisions & exceptions.

bill_title: Property Damage Caused by Limestone Mining Operations
bill_desc: Provides that certain property owners who have sustained property damage as result of limestone mining operations have right to file claim for compensation; requires such claims to be brought within specified period of time; requires Division of Administrative Hearings to adjudicate such claims; provides annual appropriation; requires state to compensate property owners' whose claims are upheld for certain costs; provides for annual funding & compensation for such claims.

Specifies that issuance of guidance document or other statement interpreting statute without express statutory delegation to issue such guidance is an invalid exercise; requires statement of estimated regulatory costs for proposed or existing rules; requires retrospective cost-benefits analysis for specified rules after specified period; requires publication of materials used to produce estimates of regulatory costs in specified fashion; provides additional requirements for cost-benefit analyses; revises requirements for review of rules by JPAC; requires additional information to be published in FAC; provides for expiration of rules after specified period unless readopted; provides requirements for readoption process; providing exceptions to expiration & requires review of such exempt rules; provides for limited extension of expiration in certain circumstances; provides that party subject to enforcement action may challenge action on basis that agency lacked statutory authority for rule or guidance document; provides for challenges to rules for failure to comply with specified provisions.

bill_title: Bonuses for Employees of Property Appraisers
bill_desc: Authorizes specified property appraisers to budget for & pay specified bonuses to employees, pending specified approval.

Provides registration requirement for offices that perform specified surgeries; revises standards of practice for office surgeries & health care professionals who practice at such offices; provides liability requirements.

Requires original equipment manufacturer to make available any documentation, parts, & tools, required for diagnosis, maintenance, or repair of motorized wheelchair & parts for motorized wheelchair; requires original equipment manufacturer of motorized wheelchair with electronic security lock to make available any special documentation, parts, & tools, needed to access & reset lock when disabled in course of diagnosis, maintenance, or repair of motorized wheelchair; provides that violation of act is unlawful practice under Florida Deceptive & Unfair Trade Practices Act; provides that original equipment manufacturer is not required to divulge trade secrets.

bill_title: Toll Exemptions for Purple Heart Medal Recipients
bill_desc: Revises eligibility for toll exemptions to include operators displaying Purple Heart specialty license plate or Purple Heart special motorcycle license plate

bill_title: Transportation Network Company and Driver Insurance Requirements
bill_desc: Revises automobile insurance requirements for transportation network companies & drivers.

bill_title: Complaints Against Law Enforcement and Correctional Officers
bill_desc: Requires copy of complaint, signed by complainant under oath, to be provided to law enforcement officers & correctional officers who are under investigation; prohibits certain personnel action from being taken against law enforcement officer or correctional officer unless such officer receives copy of complaint signed under oath by complainant; prohibits investigative file of certain investigations of law enforcement officers or correctional officers from being included in such officer's personnel file; prohibits existence of certain investigations from affecting officer's ability to receive promotion, raise, or other commendation; requires complaint against law enforcement officer or correctional officer to be in writing & signed under oath by person filing complaint; provides penalties for making false complaint.

Requires OFR to supervise virtual currency kiosk businesses; prohibits virtual currency kiosk business from operating without registering or renewing its registration in accordance with certain provisions; specifies that certain money transmitters are exempt from registration but are subject to certain provisions; requires that certain entities that perform or prevent certain actions be licensed as money services businesses; provides that virtual currency kiosk business registration is not transferable or assignable; specifies requirements for specified disclosures & attestations displayed by virtual currency kiosk.

bill_title: Ad Valorem Tax Exemption for Nonprofit Homes for the Aged
bill_desc: Revises eligibility requirement for Florida limited partnerships applying for certain ad valorem tax exemption.

Revises provisions relating to who may serve as surety; revises provisions concerning forfeiture notices; revises requirements concerning extradition of defendants; revise provisions relating to forfeiture, cancellations of bonds, & bond on appeal; adds bail agents to membership of public safety coordinating councils.

bill_title: Court-ordered Sealing of Criminal History Records
bill_desc: Revises eligibility requirements for court-ordered sealing of criminal history records; authorizes courts to seal additional adjudications of guilt in certain circumstances.

Creates Interstate Compact for School Psychologists; provides for recognition of school psychologist licenses in member states; authorizes member state to require licensure; requires member states to meet criteria to participate in compact; establishes Interstate Compact for School Psychologists Commission; provides membership, duties, & powers; provides for state enforcement of compact; provides for termination of compact membership; requires facilitation of exchange of specified information between member states.

bill_title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Interstate Compact for School Psychologists
bill_desc: Provides exemptions from public meetings & records requirements for Interstate Compact for School Psychologists Commission & its executive committee; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemptions; provides statements of public necessity.
Removes prohibition of awarding benefits to person who has felony drug conviction for trafficking; removes specified requirements in order for person convicted of drug felony to receive benefits.

bill_title: Sickle Cell Care Management and Treatment Education
bill_desc: Requires specified continuing education course for first licensure & certification renewal for specified health care professions; provides requirements for such courses; authorizes appropriate boards to adopt rules.

bill_title: Instructional Personnel and School Administrator Salaries
bill_desc: Instructional Personnel and School Administrator Salaries
Revises requirement for instruction on CPR & use of AED; requires each public school to develop cardiac emergency response plan (CERP); & provides school, CERP, & training requirements.

bill_title: Licensure Requirements for Surveyors and Mappers
bill_desc: Requires Board of Professional Surveyors & Mappers to establish & administer 1st Step Florida Surveyors & Mappers Credentialing & Licensing Protocol as temporary alternative pathway to licensure; provides requirements for eligibility to take surveyor & mapper licensure examination under protocol.

bill_title: Identification Cards for Public Works Employees
bill_desc: Requires OPPAGA to produce report on how state could provide an ID card for public works employees identifying them as first responders; provides requirements for report.

bill_title: Middle School and High School Start Times
bill_desc: Deletes requirements relating to middle school and high school start times.
Requires public schools to create School Staff Assistance for Emergencies (SAFE) Team & school elopement plan; provides requirements for SAFE Teams, elopement plans, & schools.
Directs DHSMV to develop Miami Dade College license plate; provides for distribution & use of fees collected from sale of plate.

Requires health care facilities to implement & maintain staffing plans; specifies minimum staffing levels for direct care registered nurses based on hospital or clinical unit setting; requires that patients be cared for only in hospital or clinical units that meet specified minimum staffing levels; prohibits health care facilities from using video cameras or monitors as substitute for direct observation; exempts health care facilities from minimum staffing level requirements during declared state of emergency; provides whistle-blower protections; creates cause of action; prohibits employers from taking actions with respect to employment for certain unionized staff.

Provides conduct that constitutes dangerous excessive speeding; authorizes, rather than requires, officer to indicate applicable civil penalty on certain traffic citations; requires person cited for certain driving infractions to appear at scheduled hearing.

Provides purpose & requirements for patient-directed medical orders; authorizes use of telehealth; requires that certain health care services be provided to principal regardless of decision to withhold or withdraw life-prolonging procedures.

bill_title: Emergency Opioid Antagonists in Public K-12 Schools and Postsecondary Educational Institutions
bill_desc: Authorizes public schools to purchase, use, & maintain supply of emergency opioid antagonists that meet specified criteria, rather than only naloxone; & revises definition of term "emergency opioid antagonist."
Proposes amendment to State Constitution to create $100,000 exemption from assessed value of real property for all levies.
Creates certain exemption from all taxation for real property;

Reclassifies intern registrations as associate registrations for professions of clinical social work, marriage & family therapy, & mental health counseling; removes requirement that licensed mental health professional be present on premises when registered associates, formerly classified as registered interns, are providing clinical services in private practice setting.
Authorizes community redevelopment agency to use specified percentage of tax increment financing funds for certain business support services in carrying out approved community redevelopment plans.

bill_title: Rent of Affordable Housing Dwelling Units
bill_desc: Prohibits certain landlords of specified dwelling units from increasing rent during term of rental agreement.

bill_title: Home and Service Warranty Association Financial Requirements
